banner.title: Security Reviews
banner.text: Security reviews ensure that users review policy enforcement on Azure subscriptions and AWS accounts, reducing the risk of implementing ineffective rules. Conduct a security review before you write application or additional organization policies for your subscription.

banner.title: Viewing Cloud Inventory
banner.text: Browse your inventory of all onboarded cloud resources. Use filtering to display specific resources.

banner.title: Maps
banner.text: The Cloud Map is an interactive connectivity map of cloud-native resources. It helps your organization visualize and analyze your cloud resources and their traffic flows across hybrid, multi-cloud environments.

banner.title: Viewing Cloud Traffic Flows
banner.text: Browse the traffic flowing to and from your onboarded cloud resources. Filter the displayed traffic flows by resource type, flow status, time windows, and more. Use traffic flow information to help write policies.

banner.title: Reports
banner.text: View all the reports generated in Cloud, including ad-hoc reports, scheduled reports, and report exports from across the product.

banner.title: Managing Cloud Applications
banner.text: View details about your approved applications. Click the links provided for each application to explore the inventory, map, and policy views.

banner.title: Managing Application Deployments
banner.text: Browse and manage Application Deployments of cloud resources. Define new deployments with deployment stacks that discover application topologies and apply policies.
